Ddala Allah awulidde ebigambo by'omukyala ey'emulugunyizza gy'oli ku bba era n'awaaba eri Allah era Allah abadde awulira ebigambo bye mubadde muwanyisiganya anti Allah bulijjo awulira era alaba.

Abo bonna mu mmwe abagamba bakyala baabwe nti emigongo gyabwe giringa egya bannyaabwe (abo be bakigamba) tebabangako ba maama baabwe. Ba maama baabwe beebo abaabazaala. (mu kwogera batyo) mazima bo boogera ekigambo ekibi. Mu kiseera kye kimu nga kigunje. Wabula mazima ddala Allah alekera era asonyiwa.

Abo bonna abazira bakazi baabwe olw'okulayira nti ku bo balinga bannyaabwe ate oluvannyuma ne baddayo eri ekyo kye baali balayiridde (oyo akikola) ateekwa okuta omuddu nga tannaba kuddayo kulabagana na mukyala we. Ekyo nno kye muteekwa okukola, anti Allah amanyi nnyo byonna bye mukola.

Oyo aba tasobodde kuta muddu nga tannalabagana na mukyalawe ateekwa okusiiba emyezi ebiri nga gigoberegana, wabula oyo aba tasobodde ateekwa okuliisa bamasiikiini nkaaga. Ekyo kibafuule abakkiriza Allah n'Omubaka We, ago Mateeka ga Allah era bulijjo abawakanya Amateeka ga Allah, n'abawakanya Eddiini ya Allah bagenda kutuukibwako ebibonerezo ebiruma.

Mazima abo abawakanya Allah n'Omubaka We baswavu nga abaabasooka bwe baaswazibwa, ate nga twassa amateeka agannyonnyola (Haraamu ne Halaali) naye abo abagawakanya bajja kutuukibwako ebibonerezo ebigenda okubanyoomesa.
Olunaku Allah lw'alibazuukiza bonna n'ababuulira ebyo bye baakola, Allah yabikuŋŋaanya n'abikomekkereza. So nga ate bo baabyerabira. Bulijjo Allah Mujulizi ku buli kintu.

Abaffe tomanyi nti mazima Allah amanyi ebyo ebiri mu ggulu omusanvu n'ebyo ebiri mu nsi, nga tewali kafubo konna ka kabe ka basatu okuggyako nga Yye waakuna n'okumanya Kwe, wadde ak'abataano okuggyako nga Yye waamukaaga wadde abatono abatenkana basatu oba abali waggulu w'omukaaga okuggyako Allah aba nabo awo wonna webali, oluvannyuma Allah ku Lunaku lw’Enkomerero agenda kubategeeza ebyo byonna bye baali bakola, anti Allah amanyi buli kintu kyonna.

Abaffe tolaba abo abaagaanibwa okukola obufubo (obw'enkwe) oluvannyuma ne baddamu ekyo kyenyini ekyabagaanibwa, nga boogeraganya wakati waabwe mu nkukutu olw'okukola ebikyamu n'obulabe n'okujeemera Omubaka. Era nga bwe baba bazze gy'oli bakulamusa n'ekiramuso ekitali ekyo Allah kye yakuteekerawo, nga bwe bagamba mu mitima gyabwe nti lwaki Allah tatubonereza olw'ebyo bye twogera. Omuliro Jahannama gwe bagenda okuyingira gubamala. Nayo nno nkomerero mbi.

Abange mmwe abakkiriza bwe muba nga muteesa mu kyama temuteesanga okukola ekibi kyonna oba obulabe oba okujeemera Omubaka. Muteesenga byakukola bulungi na kutya Allah. Era mutye Allah anti Gy'ali gye mugenda okukuŋŋaanyirizibwa.

Mazima okuteeseganya mu kyama mu ngeri embi n'okukola obulabe kikolwa kya Sitaane (nga nekigendererwa kye) kunyiiza bakkiriza. Ekyo tekiyinza kubaleetera kabi konna, okuggyako nga Allah akkirizza era Abakkiriza bateekwa kwesiga Allah Yekka.

Abange mmwe abakkiriza bwe muba mugambiddwa nti mwefunze mu ntuula (ne bannammwe bafune ebifo) mukikole. Allah ajja ku basobozesa okugaziwa, ate bwe muba mugambiddwa okusituka (okuva mu kifo olw'ensonga yonna) musituke, anti Allah asitula amadaala mu mmwe abakkiriza n'abo abaaweebwa okumanya. Bulijjo Allah Mumanyi nnyo W'ebyo byonna bye mukola.

Abange mmwe abakkiriza bwe mwagalanga okwogera n'Omubaka musookenga kusaddaka, nga temunnayogera naye. Ekyo ky'ekirungi gye muli era ky'ekisinga era kibatukuliza ddala. Naye bwe muba temulina kye musaddaaka mazima Allah Musonyiyi Waakisa.

Abaffe muzitoowereddwa okuwaayo Saddaaka nga temunnaba kwogera ne Nnabbi. Kale bwe kiba nga kibalemye oba nga ne Allah abasonyiye, kale nno muyimirizeewo Esswala era mutoole ne Zzaka mugondere Allah n'Omubaka We. Mazima Allah amanyidde ddala nnyo ebyo bye mukola.

Abaffe tewamanya abo abakwanagana n'abantu Allah be yasunguwalira, abantu abo mu butuufu si ba mu mmwe wadde si ba mu bali (be bakwanagana nabo) ne batuuka n'okulayira ku bulimba nga ate ddala bamanyi (ekituufu).
Allah yabategekera ebibonerezo ebikambwe, anti mazima byonna bye baakolanga bibi.
(Okulayira kwabwe nti Basiraamu) baakifuula ekyokuwona, olwo nno ne baziyiza abantu okukola emirimu gya Allah, bagenda kutuukibwako ebibonerezo ebinyoomesa.
Emmaali yaabwe n'abaana baabwe tebigenda kubagasa n'akamu mu maaso g'a Allah. Abo be bantu boomu Muliro ab'okugubeeramu obugenderevu.
Olunaku Allah lw'alibazuukiza bonna ne bamulayirira nga bwe baabalayirira mmwe ku nsi nga balowooza nti kye bakoze kya kubagasa. Abange, abo nno be balimba bennyini.
Sitaane yabeefunza okutuusa lwe yabeerabiza okwogera ku Allah. Abo nno be bagoberezi ba Sitaane. Mukimanye nti mazima ab'ekibiina kya Sitaane be b'okufaafaaganirwa.
Mazima abo abawakanya Allah n'Omubaka We ba mu bantu abanyoomebwa.
(Allah) yakakasa dda nti nze Allah n'Ababaka bange tuli baakuwangula anti Allah Waamaanyi. Nnantakubwakumukono.

Tewali bantu bonna abakkiriza Allah n'Olunaku lw’Enkomerero baalibadde batiitiibya abo abawakanya Allah n'Omubaka We, ka babe bakitaabwe, oba baana baabwe, oba baganda baabwe, oba nga baaluganda lwabwe olw'okumpi. Abo nno (abatakola ekyo) Allah yatebenkeza Obukkiriza mu mitima gyabwe, n'abawagira n'amaanyi agava Gy'ali era nga agenda kubayingiza Ejjana egikulukutira wansi waazo emigga, nga baakubeera mu zo olubeerera. Allah yabasiima nga nabo bwe baamusiima. Kisaana kimanyike nti mazima abo be bantu ba Allah, abantu ba Allah be b'okwesiimira ddala.
